_about: Every word the page shows that is not an item's or an upgrade's (those are in items.json and upgrades.json).
title: Pursuer
subtitle: Don't hold on to anything for too long.
credit: Made by Sam Gilson. Built with Builder: a Rust core, a WebAssembly shim and a WebGL page. Art drawn in TikZ.
music_note: Pick the chase music on the record player in the house.
pieces_loosed: pieces of the city knocked loose
prompt_holding: Holding {item}. Let go of E to put it down.
prompt_enter: Press E to get in the car
prompt_run: Run to the car in the garage
prompt_record: Press E to change the record
flip_hint: Upside down? Hold R to roll over.
no_webgl: This browser cannot draw WebGL 2, which Pursuer needs.
controls: Pick something up; get in the car
Roll the car back onto its wheels
Jump; in the car, leap once it can
The car's other abilities, drawn at random as you survive: each shows its key on the left
